target_region.prompt: Derived from cross-cloud answer: latency-acceptable → region by cost (us-east-1)
target_region.design_consequence: Bedrock resources deploy in us-east-1; model availability is checked for this region

compliance.prompt: Do you have any compliance or regulatory requirements?
compliance.design_consequence: Full model catalog, any Bedrock region; global. inference profiles allowed

ai_framework.prompt: Which AI framework or orchestration layer are you using?
ai_framework.design_consequence: Swap SDK calls to Bedrock SDK; evaluate AgentCore (Harness) if planning agentic

ai_priority.prompt: What matters most for your AI application?

ai_monthly_spend.prompt: Monthly AI spend with your current AI providers? (default applied)
ai_monthly_spend.design_consequence: $500-$2K band sets token volume and model tier assumptions

ai_model_baseline.prompt: Detected models from the AI profile
ai_model_baseline.design_consequence: The detected models are the quality/latency baseline for Bedrock comparison

ai_vision.prompt: What input types must the model accept: text only, images (vision), or audio/video?

ai_token_volume.design_consequence: high sets throughput and caching analysis

ai_complexity.design_consequence: Sonnet 5 recommended; Haiku may suffice with prompt engineering

ai_critical_feature.design_consequence: Default recommendation from Q2 priority stands

mantle_requirements.prompt: Mantle-only requirements (asynchronous inference, provider-run tools, Projects/Workspaces, single-Region processing)
mantle_requirements.design_consequence: Entries with a selector route that workload to bedrock-mantle; no entry keeps bedrock-runtime with an explicit assumption

startup_program_status.prompt: Have you applied for AWS Activate credits?
startup_program_status.design_consequence: Surface both tiers; recommend checking with investors/accelerator for Org ID
